subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can give a clear definition of a Unit 2 word.
I can guess technology words from definitions.
I can write about what I learnt in my learning diary.

tf.s: “It’s a thing you use to print your homework” defines a printer.
tf.why: A printer puts your homework on paper.

tf.s: You put headphones on your eyes to watch a film.
tf.why: You put headphones on your ears to listen.

tf.s: A password is a secret word you type to open an app or computer.
An e-reader is a device you use to read e-books.
tf.why: You can read and sometimes listen to books on it.

tf.s: To upload a photo means to delete it from your phone.
tf.why: Upload means to put a photo from your device onto the internet.

tf.s: “It’s something you can …” is a useful way to start a definition.
tf.why: It helps your partner guess the word.

tf.s: A good definition says the word you are describing.
tf.why: Don’t say the word; describe it so your partner can guess.

tf.s: A learning diary is where you write what you did and learnt.
tf.why: For example: Today, I played the definitions game.

tf.s: A printer is a device you use to take selfies.
tf.why: You take selfies with a phone or tablet camera.

tf.s: A smartphone is a thing you can use to send messages.
tf.why: Yes, you can send messages with a smartphone.

boxes.q: “You use it to print your homework.” What is it?
“A device you use to read e-books.” What is it?
boxes.why: An e-reader is for reading e-books.

boxes.q: “You put them on your ears to listen to music.” What are they?
Complete: It’s a thing you use ___ take photos.
boxes.why: a thing you use to + verb.

boxes.q: “A secret word you type to open an app.” What is it?
boxes.why: A password keeps your app safe.

boxes.q: Which sentence is a good start for a definition?
boxes.why: It’s something you can … describes a thing.

o: put a photo onto the internet
boxes.why: You send the photo from your device to the internet.

boxes.q: Complete the diary: Today, I ___ the definitions game.
boxes.why: We use the past simple for what we did today.

boxes.q: “You click on it to open an app.” What is it?
boxes.why: An icon is the small picture you click on.

boxes.q: “The part of a tablet you look at.” What is it?

mcq.q: Which is a good definition of “password”?
o: It’s a secret word you type to open an app or computer.
It’s a thing you wear on your ears.
It’s a place where you watch films.
It’s a machine that prints paper.
mcq.why: A password is a secret word.

mcq.q: Which word means “put a photo from your device onto the internet”?
mcq.why: Upload means sending something up to the internet.

mcq.q: What do you write in a learning diary?
o: What you did and learnt in the lesson
mcq.why: A diary helps you think about your learning.

mcq.q: Which sentence starter is for a definition?
o: It’s a thing you use to …
mcq.why: It’s a thing you use to … tells what something does.

mcq.q: Define “smartphone” for your partner. Which is best?
o: It’s something you can use to call people and send messages.
mcq.why: A good definition describes the thing without saying its name.

mcq.q: Your partner says: “It’s a thing you use to listen to music on your ears.” What do you guess?

o: Today, I played the definitions game and I learnt to describe devices.
I am play the game yesterday.
mcq.why: It uses the past simple correctly and says what you learnt.

mcq.q: Why is “It’s a printer” a bad definition?
o: It says the word, so there is nothing to guess.
mcq.why: A definition should describe, not name, the word.

o: A device you use to read e-books.
mcq.why: It says what the device is used for.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT fit: printer, laptop, headphones, theatre?
mcq.why: A theatre is a place; the others are devices.
